title: Tecsys TS9500-ISDB Digital Modulator
excerpt: Suitable for ISDB-T digital terrestrial TV transmission. It has two ASI inputs that can receive TS or BTS. Built-in 10MHz high-precision oscillator with 10MHz external input option. Output 44MHz with digital pre-corrector. Fully developed in Brazil, it is mounted in a 19 "aluminum cabinet, with an active ventilation unit and a friendly user interface via front panel keys and LCD display.
body:
Suitable for ISDB-T digital terrestrial TV transmission. It has two ASI inputs that can receive TS or BTS. Built-in 10MHz high-precision oscillator with 10MHz external input option. Output 44MHz with digital pre-corrector. Fully developed in Brazil, it is mounted in a 19 “aluminum cabinet, with an active ventilation unit and a friendly user interface via front panel keys and LCD display.
